lessons.claim: HOOMD's rotational_diffusion is the director decay rate itself. It was measured as Lambda/D_r = 1.00 in both 2D and 3D and is not the standard theory's (d-1)D_r. To reproduce the physical D_r in 3D you have to put in twice the value. The free-ABP effective diffusion is D_eff = D_t + v0^2/(d*Lambda), and the commonly used v0^2/(2(d-1)D_r) is only coincidentally right in 2D (a measured +29~31% in 3D)
